identity_contract: Original iOS descriptors: CoWatchWatchEndpointWrapperCommand extension 462702848, watchEndpoint command field 1; YTIWatchEndpoint extension 48687757, videoId field 1. Require one length-delimited field at each step and a valid 11-character ID. Do not borrow current playback identity.
admission: Resource family + singular typed semantic paths + per-instance native consumer ownership. Revision remains diagnostic/instance identity, never an admission allowlist for the two live recipes.

native_consumers.strategy: Private keyed ELMNodeController callbacks on accepted factory-owned descendants; no global ELMTextNode/ELMImageNode setElement observers.
native_consumers.retirement: Remove only private keys on new source/factory/settings generation and binding destruction; weak node/controller references.

remaining_scope: New structural families need a reviewed recipe; no arbitrary protobuf search authorizes writes.; Existing legacy bundled compact/card/context recipes remain pinned.; Interactive titles need command-range remapping and remain original.; Player cover is excluded; watch metadata supports titles only.; Unknown watch owner or model layout remains original with directed checkpoints.; No device validation yet; watch interaction root cause remains unconfirmed.
